== Summary ==
Only surviving copy (thumbnail, 50×38). Decipher's caption: "Nikki Frederich of New York joins other card junkies in opening and sorting Star Wars CCG Enhanced Cloud City packs." Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].
